title: Merge Multiple Notes Feature
body:
I love this app. It’s quick and easy to jot things down as I go about my day. However, there are times when I come to the realisation that more than one of my notes are related to the same topic and it would make sense for them to be in one note. 
Being able to select multiple notes and merge would be very useful for me. 

Solana S.
author: Anonymously0123

title: Get us more effectiveness
body: A Redo & Undo option needed. Make it easier to sync info to other devices without crashing. Allow user to get back to the same place they were after closing the app.
author: VisitorOfEarth

title: Recommendation
body: Make the app have a redo and an Undo button to reverse the last few changes someone have made. Make It possible to come out of the app and go back to what someone was looking at instead of searching for what I was typing/reading before.
